blocks.prompt: 6. If \(x\) is very nearly equal 1, then prove that \(px^{p} - qx^{q} \approx (p - q)x^{p+q}\).
blocks.explanation:
"\(x\) taqreeban 1 ke barabar hai" ka matlab hai \(x = 1 + h\), jahan \(h\) bahut chhota hai. Is liye \(h^{2}\) aur us se bari powers chhor sakte hain.
Saabit kya karna hai? Ke dono sides \(h\) wali term tak barabar hain.
Rule kaunsa? \((1 + h)^{n} \approx 1 + nh\).
Plan: \(x^{p}\), \(x^{q}\) aur \(x^{p+q}\) ko \(1 + nh\) ki shakal mein khol kar dono sides ka muqabla.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x\) taqreeban 1 hai.
Saabit karna hai: \(px^{p} - qx^{q} \approx (p - q)x^{p+q}\).
Tareeqa: \(x = 1 + h\) rakhenge jahan \(h\) bahut chhota hai. Binomial theorem se \((1 + h)^{n} \approx 1 + nh\), jab \(h^{2}\) chhor diya jaye. Dono sides ko \(h\) mein khol kar dikhayenge ke ek hi cheez banti hai. Yeh tareeqa isliye zaroori hai ke binomial series ko chhota number chahiye; \(x\) khud chhota nahi, lekin \(x - 1 = h\) chhota hai.

Left side
\[px^{p} - qx^{q} = p(1 + h)^{p} - q(1 + h)^{q}\]
\[\approx p(1 + ph) - q(1 + qh)\]
\[= (p - q) + (p^{2} - q^{2})h\]
Kyun: Dono powers ko \(1 + nh\) se khola. Phir constants alag jama kiye (\(p - q\)) aur \(h\) wali terms alag (\(p^{2}h - q^{2}h\)).

Factor banayein
\[= (p - q) + (p - q)(p + q)h\]
\[= (p - q)\left[1 + (p + q)h\right]\]
Kyun: \(p^{2} - q^{2}\) do squares ka farq hai, jo \((p - q)(p + q)\) banta hai. Ab dono terms mein \(p - q\) common hai, usay bahar nikala.
Dhyan dein: yahi factor nikalna is sawal ki chaabi hai; is ke baghair right side se milana mushkil lagta hai.

Right side
\[(p - q)x^{p+q} = (p - q)(1 + h)^{p+q}\]
\[\approx (p - q)\left[1 + (p + q)h\right]\]
Kyun: Yahan power \(p + q\) hai, to \(1 + nh\) mein \(n = p + q\) rakha.

Muqabla
\[px^{p} - qx^{q} \approx (p - q)x^{p+q}\]
Kyun: Dono sides bilkul ek hi expression \((p - q)[1 + (p + q)h]\) ban gayin, is liye taqreeban barabar hain.

Tasdeeq: \(p = 3,\ q = 1,\ x = 1.01\)
\[3(1.01)^{3} - 1.01 = 2.080903\]
\[2(1.01)^{4} = 2.081208\]
Kyun: Ek misaal le kar dekha: dono values bahut qareeb hain. Farq \(h^{2} = 0.0001\) jitni terms ka hai, jo humne chhori thin.
blocks.final_answer: Jab \(x\) taqreeban 1 ho to \(px^{p} - qx^{q} \approx (p - q)x^{p+q}\). Saabit ho gaya.
